hook: Scout your next opponent, then vote the water up to sink their small units, or down for gold.
loop: Vote your Level up or down, after scouting your next opponent.
Each Vote grows your units; Lowering also pays gold.
The water halves low-Health enemies' Attack; Tiddy Mun drowns them outright.

growth.line: Each Vote gives permanent stats, several Votes a turn; Mills buff the whole board late.

feel.early: Plain bodies, first Votes, little water yet.
feel.mid: Choose a side: Raise to sink, Lower for gold.
feel.late: Mills grow everything; Tiddy Mun drowns short boards.

stars.why: Lifts neighbours above the water, so placement becomes the puzzle.
Every Vote, either way, grows the whole board: the capstone.
A coot that wants the water: Dives and Floods.

card_short.u04: Each Raise buffs your lowest-Health unit permanently.
card_short.u06: Votes each turn; grows +1/+1 every Vote.

card_short.u10: Once a turn, Votes again after you Vote, either way.

builds.name: High Water
builds.line: Raise every turn; Stretch-Holder keeps yours dry, coots Dive, Tiddy Mun drowns.

builds.name: Drain
builds.line: Lower every turn for gold and stats; you fight in no water.

builds.name: The Seesaw
builds.line: Vote toward each opponent; Mills and Sail-Setter pay either way.

liked: The only tribe that changes both boards at once; scouting becomes a vote each turn.
Stretch-Holder against Almoner: choosing who stands beside the Holder is a real puzzle.
worries: Watch: a fed Gauge-Keeper plus Tiddy Mun can drown most of an enemy board.
Watch: Keeper's Overflow never resets, Penningmeester's gold stacks; Rafting Coot's triggers hard to follow.
changed: Gauge-Keeper now Floods by half its own Health, so the water keeps up late.
Raise now pays: Schouw-Walker buffs your lowest-Health unit on each Raise.
Under halves Attack both ways; fight-only water got its own word, Flood.
verdict: A tribe for scouts who like picking a side: read your next opponent, then flood or drain.
